EARLY DEVELOPMENT

What’s changing.

A record of the work, and a way to help decide what comes next.

Available on the Chrome Web StoreKeepItReel is free and in early development. Report problems or suggest a feature using Feedback.

30 October 2026 · Public launch

KeepItReel is now available on the Chrome Web Store. Install it, choose your optional checks and tell us what needs work.

29 October 2026 · Website preview

Added interactive YouTube, Gmail and Outlook examples, an installation guide, privacy details and a feedback composer. The website includes examples and guidance for the public early-development release.

Extension 0.3.21 · First public release

Updated public-release wording, feedback contact and privacy-policy link. The first public release includes local checks, explained warnings and reversible feed controls.

Extension 0.3.20 · Toolbar warnings

Warnings can now appear in Chrome’s toolbar while page monkeys are hidden. The badge counts distinct warning types on the current tab. Warning details remain available in the popup.

Recent improvements

  • One monkey control for supported YouTube videos and Shorts, with explanations, Hide video, Block creator and Undo.
  • Compact Gmail and Outlook indicators with explanations for visible inbox previews and supported opened messages.
  • Optional automatic hiding for suspicious posts, plus dismiss controls and incorrect-warning feedback.

What should come next?

We are collecting feedback about missed warnings, false alarms, layout issues and features people would use. Suggestions help set priorities; this list is not a commitment to a delivery date.
